limits: Only two native Linux AWG clients; GUI clients and Internet DPI were not tested.
A twelve-second control outage exceeds the one-second holding lifetime and can lose useful traffic.
A helper restart can still lose queued traffic. Kernel-purged packets are not restored by accepting their stale verdict errors.
Recovery bursts can overflow real application buffers; the larger buffer belongs only to the lab UDP receiver.
No one-second roaming guarantee; IPv6 outer transport and a long soak are outside this study.
Finite conntrack, observation, challenge, holding and replay budgets remain.
Lease tuples do not authenticate every later packet on A; B still validates every encrypted packet.
The filter supports the tested S1-S4=12 and H1-H4=1,2,3,4 profile restrictions; arbitrary AWG parameter sets are outside its current implementation.
